//! Builds the format-version-2 fixture used by zerodb-tools' upgrade tests.
//! Run from a checkout of the v0.2.0 tag:
//!   cargo run -p zerodb --example gen_v2_fixture -- <empty-dir>
use zerodb::EnvOpenOptions;

fn val(i: u32, len: usize) -> Vec<u8> {
    (0..len).map(|j| (i as usize * 31 + j * 7) as u8).collect()
}

fn main() {
    let dir = std::env::args().nth(1).expect("usage: gen_v2_fixture <empty-dir>");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
    let mut opts = EnvOpenOptions::new();
    opts.map_size(16 << 20).page_size(4096).max_dbs(8);
    let env = opts.open(&dir).unwrap();

    // Txn 1: main DB records (inline and overflow), three named DBs.
    let mut t = env.write_txn().unwrap();
    let main = env.main_database();
    for i in 0..300u32 {
        main.put(&mut t, format!("main-{i:05}").as_bytes(), &val(i, 24)).unwrap();
    }
    for i in 0..3u32 {
        main.put(&mut t, format!("main-big-{i}").as_bytes(), &val(i, 10_000 + i as usize)).unwrap();
    }
    let alpha = env.create_database(&mut t, Some(b"alpha")).unwrap();
    for i in 0..1200u32 {
        alpha.put(&mut t, &i.to_be_bytes(), &val(i, 40)).unwrap();
    }
    env.create_database(&mut t, Some(b"empty")).unwrap();
    let gamma = env.create_database(&mut t, Some(b"gamma\x00bin")).unwrap();
    for i in 0..12u32 {
        gamma.put(&mut t, &[0u8, 0xff, i as u8], &val(i, 6000)).unwrap();
    }
    t.commit().unwrap();

    // Txns 2 and 3: rewrites. A read transaction pins txn 1's pages, so every
    // commit's freed pages stay free and the free (GC) DB keeps format-2
    // records (only the newest list rides in the meta annex).
    let pin = env.read_txn().unwrap();
    for round in 0..2u32 {
        let mut t = env.write_txn().unwrap();
        for i in (round..1200).step_by(7) {
            alpha.put(&mut t, &i.to_be_bytes(), &val(i + round, 40)).unwrap();
        }
        t.commit().unwrap();
    }
    // Small commits until the pending free pages outgrow the meta annex
    // (490 ids at 4 KiB) and spill into free-DB records.
    for round in 0..130u32 {
        let mut t = env.write_txn().unwrap();
        let i = (round * 37) % 1200;
        alpha.put(&mut t, &i.to_be_bytes(), &val(i + 7, 40)).unwrap();
        t.commit().unwrap();
    }
    // Last txn: one large delete, a long free-page list in one GC record.
    let mut t = env.write_txn().unwrap();
    for i in 150..1050u32 {
        alpha.delete(&mut t, &i.to_be_bytes()).unwrap();
    }
    for i in 3..9u32 {
        gamma.delete(&mut t, &[0u8, 0xff, i as u8]).unwrap();
    }
    t.commit().unwrap();
    drop(pin);
}
